generator.algorithm: balanced planted classes; uniformly sample fixed-count cross-class edges conditioned on connectivity
generator.density_definition: percentage of eligible cross-class pairs; rounded half up
generator.evaluation_policy: untouched by model calls at generation; reproducible, not cryptographically hidden
limitations: planted distribution only; no hardness guarantee
uniqueness is labeled-graph equality, not graph-isomorphism screening
colorability witnesses never enter worker inputs
